title: Kenya secondary curriculum guide
intro: Explore learning areas used in Kenya's secondary and Senior School curriculum, then choose a subject to build a lesson.
updated_note: Subject groupings are based on the KICD Grade 10 and Grade 11 curriculum-design pages. Confirm the current official design before making school or examination decisions.

groups.name: Languages
groups.description: Communication, reading, writing and language development.

groups.name: Pure Sciences
groups.description: Scientific understanding, investigation and evidence-based thinking.

groups.name: Applied Sciences
groups.description: Science and technology applied to everyday life, health and practical problem-solving.

groups.name: Humanities
groups.description: People, places, history, citizenship and society.

groups.name: Religious Education
groups.description: Faith, values, ethics and responsible participation in society.

groups.name: Arts & Sports
groups.description: Creative expression, performance, wellbeing and physical development.

groups.name: Technical Studies
groups.description: Design, making, digital skills and practical career-oriented learning.
